cohort: The study included 953 children participating in the Study of Mothers and Infants Life Events Affecting Oral Health (SMILE) birth cohort study, based in Adelaide, Australia.
finding: Children breastfed for 12 months or more had a significantly lower risk of being overweight/obese at 24-36 months compared to those breastfed for less than 17 weeks, while the age of solid food introduction was not associated with this risk.
